steps.subquestion: 高风险关系占总关系的百分比是多少？
steps.cypher:
MATCH ()-[r]->() 
WITH count(r) AS total_rels, 
     sum(CASE WHEN r.risk_level = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_rels 
RETURN toFloat(high_risk_rels) / total_rels * 100 AS high_risk_percentage
